description: Arrange several models into a single scene and get one link that reopens it exactly: same models, same positions, rotations and scales. Open that link on a phone and the whole arrangement stands in the real room. Coordinates are metres on the floor: x is right, z is forward with negative values further away, so { x: 0, z: -2 } is two metres in front of the viewer. This is the tool to reach for when someone wants to see more than one thing at once.

models.description: The models to arrange, in placement order.

x.description: Metres right of the viewer. Default 0.

yaw.description: Rotation in radians about the vertical axis.

z.description: Metres in front of the viewer, negative is further away. Default -1.6.

page_url.description: The page hosting the studio. Defaults to the hosted demo.

title.description: A name for the scene, used in the summary.

name: compose_ar_scene
title: Arrange models into one AR scene and get a link
